[RHIM.5.2.1] When a `hydrate_*` call reuses the correlation id of a prior
hydration, the engine must retract every fact of a hydration target carrying that
`corr`, and every live `HydrationComplete` and `CallError` carrying it
([LCRS.6.2.1]), after the budget gate passes (RHIM.5.1.2) and before it dispatches
the call, so before the adapter asserts the new set ([LHYD.6.3]). The integrator
does not track and retract the prior batch.
